segments.name: sales and shipping
segments.description: Sells LNG from its liquefaction facilities.
segments.evidence: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company's sales and shipping business met the criteria to be a reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Buyers pay for LNG under sales agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell LNG throughout the full lifecycle of our LNG facilities—during testing and commissioning, operations under contracted sales agreements, and through the sale of excess production capacity.
